policy: Working-copy docs/design/ASSET_REQUEST_RAIL_PARK_KO.md §5.12 (with §5.11 ground catenary setbacks), including the 2026-11-18 cities-claude decisions on the line edit contract (BLOCK 1) and X catenary supports (BLOCK 2)
review: Implemented by cities-gpt; independent review BLOCK 1 (line edit contract) and BLOCK 2 (catenary supports at exactly facing 32m ports) fixed by cities-claude with one regression suite each. Final native GL capture saved and visually inspected by cities-claude.

validation.native_capture: python tools/run_dotnet.py --timeout 35 godot --path cities_do --rendering-method gl_compatibility --rendering-driver opengl3 --max-fps 30 --resolution 1280x820 --script res://tests/test_terminal_turnback_native.gd -- --p5-capture=D:/project/simcity/artifacts/p5-terminal-turnback/turnback-1280.png
validation.log_provenance: Raw combined stdout/stderr redirected directly from the wrapper; exit zero and no SCRIPT ERROR, ERROR, FAIL or WARNING lines in final runs. All headless except test_terminal_turnback_native, whose log is the capture run (its 12th check is the explicit framebuffer save).

regressions.test_terminal_turnback_edit.log: BLOCK 1: native worker consist running on a turnback line; a physical loop is added and only the dwell time is edited -> stored turnback mode, terminal ports, both X and the plan are kept and the same consist keeps running and reverses through the far X. A stop-changing edit re-plans onto the loop and the extant consist is frozen in place (P3), then resumes from its own position when the original route is restored. Fails 5 checks with the old update path.
regressions.test_terminal_turnback_catenary.log: BLOCK 2: real stations whose ports face at exactly 32m -> both X keep two contact wires, every support pole is at least 1m from both station lots and the span is 30m (max wire-to-S 0.438m <= 0.62m). Fails 14 checks with the old far support.

capture.invocation: python tools/run_dotnet.py --timeout 35 godot --path cities_do --rendering-method gl_compatibility --rendering-driver opengl3 --max-fps 30 --resolution 1280x820 --script res://tests/test_terminal_turnback_native.gd -- --p5-capture=D:/project/simcity/artifacts/p5-terminal-turnback/turnback-1280.png
capture.expected_assertion: A rail car in the current native worker publication has its center within 4m of the departing X center; the retained composition contains the full 3-car consist, X meshes and wires, and loaded station artwork. No framebuffer read or save occurs without the explicit flag.
capture.inspection: Opened and inspected: the white 3-car consist created by real viewport clicks leaves the original station artwork; its lead car sits between the X end supports (1m and 31m pole pairs) around the X center at the viewport anchor, with the crossing X contact wires overhead. The line is created at zoom 0.70; the capture composition zooms to 2.0 on the same X center only for legibility.

notes: Rail radius is 65m; metro uses the exact radius implied by 32m longitudinal and 8.3m lateral dimensions (nominal 32.9m).

Near X wires share the existing required 1m station setback support (span 31m, max 0.54m from the S path). The far support stays at the 32m host end unless its poles would break another station lot's 1m setback; then it also moves 1m inside. Ports facing at exactly 32m therefore get a 30m span (measured max 0.438m from the S path). All within the 0.62m half-width; no straight longer than 32m is required and no poles are added.

Edit contract: an update with the same stop list is a schedule-only edit. The stored row (turnback mode, terminal ports, X ownership) is kept and only validated as stored, so an obstructed route still rejects atomically with the exact message and nothing is re-chosen; a running consist keeps running even if a physical loop appeared meanwhile. Only a changed stop list re-plans; if an extant train's rebuilt path differs, the inherited P3 freeze blocks it in place (no teleport/respawn) until the route is restored or the line is recreated.
Freight and old physical-loop rows retain loop behavior. Road buses use the existing road plan and simulation.
No additional management UI, no E2/E3/E4 edits, no edits to protected docs or source assets/import metadata. No builds, installs, imports or performance measurements.
